correctness.rationale: From Tian's full arXiv measure model, frame synthesis is J*:H0->L2(mu), ker J* contains a nonzero analytic f and equals the functions vanishing at spectral atoms. With support radius at most 1, m_{n+1}<=m_n so z multiplication is a contraction preserving ker J*. For all k, z^k f lie in kernel and are independent (P(z)f(z)=0 forces P=0 analytically); normalized coefficient support shifts at least k. Therefore synthesis kernel is infinite-dimensional with nonzero tail relations. Independent check: the bounded weighted forward shift intertwines the frame synthesis with T; normality forbids an injective Riesz-basis orbit, and shift-invariance rules out a finite-dimensional nonzero kernel. No finite experiments or arbitrary-removal claim.
